newsitem.title: JORDAN: King Hussein releases leading Jordanian dissident.
newsitem.headline: King Hussein releases leading Jordanian dissident.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan has ordered the release of a leading opposition figure who was jailed in March for branding the monarch a traitor for making peace with Israel, Jordanian television reported on Friday.
It said King Hussein called for Laith Shubailat's release in a royal decree sent to Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti.

Shubailat, head of the 35,000-member engineers union that is dominated by the opposition, was imprisoned for three years in March for "violating the dignity of the king" after scathing public attacks on King Hussein's policies, in particular Jordan's 1994 peace treaty with Israel.
"This letter stands as our decree from the moment of your receiving it to order the release of engineer Laith Shubailat," the king's letter to Kabariti said.
It said the eight months Shubailat spent behind bars were sufficient punishment.

"God knows that the period Shubailat spent in prison weighed heavily on my soul as it was on him and his family, and I, thank God, am not one who bears grudges," said the king's letter, read out on television.
